confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from one web search of cost-of-living aggregators (Wise, Numbeo, Expatistan, Livingcost, Hikersbay). The sources disagreed a lot: an inexpensive meal ranged from $10 to $25 and beer from about $3 to $6. The estimates are blended toward the middle and adjusted for July 2026, which is ski season and has steady tourist demand. Argentine peso volatility makes the USD figures less certain. No direct cocktail or wine data was searched. The cocktail is estimated at about 1.6x beer and the wine glass at about 1.1x beer, because Argentine wine is relatively cheap. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. Ushuaia's remote location and tourist premium make lodging pricier than in most Argentine cities. The FX rate is the RBA print of 18 Nov 2026 as reported by search results; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Ushuaia is a remote Patagonian tourist gateway. It is benchmarked against El Calafate and Punta Arenas; one aggregator rates Ushuaia about 7% cheaper than Punta Arenas. All three are above Argentine national price levels.
